parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED')) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0 AND status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED')) AS winning_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl < 0 AND status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED')) AS losing_trades, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pnl) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED'))::NUMERIC,2),0) AS total_pnl, COALESCE(MAX(pnl) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED')),0) AS best_trade, COALESCE(MIN(pnl) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED')),0) AS worst_trade, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0 AND status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED'))::NUMERIC,2),0) AS avg_gain_pct, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct) FILTER (WHERE pnl < 0 AND status IN ('STOP_LOSS_HIT','CLOSED'))::NUMERIC,2),0) AS avg_loss_pct FROM trades WHERE DATE(entry_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') = CURRENT_DATE
